# awscc_sagemaker_compute_quota (Data Source)

Data Source schema for AWS::SageMaker::ComputeQuota



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `activation_state` (String) Whether the compute allocation rule is active. Defaults service-side to 'Enabled' when omitted on Create.
- `cluster_arn` (String) The ARN of the EKS-orchestrated SageMaker HyperPod cluster the compute allocation definition is bound to. Slurm-orchestrated clusters are rejected by the service.
- `compute_quota_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the compute allocation definition.
- `compute_quota_config` (Attributes) Compute allocation rules: per-resource quotas, idle-borrowing strategy, and team-task preemption policy. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--compute_quota_config))
- `compute_quota_id` (String) The unique 12-character identifier of the compute allocation definition.
- `compute_quota_target` (Attributes) The team this compute allocation rule applies to. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--compute_quota_target))
- `compute_quota_version` (Number) The version of the compute allocation definition. Incremented on each successful Update; used for optimistic concurrency control.
- `creation_time` (String) The ISO-8601 timestamp at which the compute allocation definition was created.
- `description` (String) A free-form description of the compute allocation definition.
- `last_modified_time` (String) The ISO-8601 timestamp at which the compute allocation definition was last modified.
- `name` (String) The name of the compute allocation definition.
- `status` (String) The current lifecycle status of the compute allocation definition.
- `tags` (Attributes List) Tags to associate with the compute allocation definition. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

<a id="nestedatt--compute_quota_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `compute_quota_config`

Read-Only:

- `compute_quota_resources` (Attributes List) Per-instance-type compute quotas for the team. When VCpu / MemoryInGiB / Accelerators are partially specified, SageMaker auto-fills the remaining fields ratio-proportionally to the underlying instance ? Read may return values the customer did not supply (drift may flag this). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--compute_quota_config--compute_quota_resources))
- `preempt_team_tasks` (String) Team-task preemption policy. Defaults service-side to 'LowerPriority' when omitted on Create.
- `resource_sharing_config` (Attributes) Idle-resource-sharing strategy for this team's quota. When omitted, the service applies defaults (Strategy=LendAndBorrow, BorrowLimit=50). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--compute_quota_config--resource_sharing_config))

<a id="nestedatt--compute_quota_config--compute_quota_resources"></a>
### Nested Schema for `compute_quota_config.compute_quota_resources`

Read-Only:

- `accelerator_partition` (Attributes) Multi-instance GPU (MIG) partition profile and count, for fractional accelerator allocation. Service rejects MIG profiles that the chosen InstanceType does not support. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--compute_quota_config--compute_quota_resources--accelerator_partition))
- `accelerators` (Number) The number of accelerators (e.g., GPUs) of this type allocated to the team. SageMaker auto-fills VCpu / MemoryInGiB ratio-proportionally if only this is set.
- `count` (Number) The number of instances of this type allocated to the team.
- `instance_type` (String) The cluster instance type the quota applies to (e.g., 'ml.m5.xlarge', 'ml.p5.48xlarge'). Validated by the service against the supported HyperPod instance types.
- `memory_in_gi_b` (Number) The memory in GiB allocated to the team. Floating-point. SageMaker auto-fills Accelerators / VCpu ratio-proportionally if only this is set.
- `v_cpu` (Number) The number of vCPUs allocated to the team. Floating-point. SageMaker auto-fills Accelerators / MemoryInGiB ratio-proportionally if only this is set.

<a id="nestedatt--compute_quota_config--compute_quota_resources--accelerator_partition"></a>
### Nested Schema for `compute_quota_config.compute_quota_resources.accelerator_partition`

Read-Only:

- `count` (Number) The number of MIG partitions of the specified Type allocated to the team.
- `type` (String) MIG profile type. Service rejects MIG profiles that the chosen InstanceType does not support.



<a id="nestedatt--compute_quota_config--resource_sharing_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `compute_quota_config.resource_sharing_config`

Read-Only:

- `absolute_borrow_limits` (Attributes List) Per-instance-type absolute caps on resources this team can borrow. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--compute_quota_config--resource_sharing_config--absolute_borrow_limits))
- `borrow_limit` (Number) Maximum percentage of the team's idle quota that can be borrowed by other teams. Smithy admits 0..10000; in practice the service-documented operational range is 1..500. Defaults service-side to 50 when omitted on Create.
- `strategy` (String) How this team participates in idle-resource sharing.

<a id="nestedatt--compute_quota_config--resource_sharing_config--absolute_borrow_limits"></a>
### Nested Schema for `compute_quota_config.resource_sharing_config.absolute_borrow_limits`

Read-Only:

Service rejects MIG profiles that the chosen InstanceType does not support. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--compute_quota_config--resource_sharing_config--absolute_borrow_limits--accelerator_partition))
- `accelerators` (Number) The number of accelerators (e.g., GPUs) of this type allocated to the team. SageMaker auto-fills VCpu / MemoryInGiB ratio-proportionally if only this is set.
- `count` (Number) The number of instances of this type allocated to the team.
- `instance_type` (String) The cluster instance type the quota applies to (e.g., 'ml.m5.xlarge', 'ml.p5.48xlarge'). Validated by the service against the supported HyperPod instance types.
- `memory_in_gi_b` (Number) The memory in GiB allocated to the team. Floating-point. SageMaker auto-fills Accelerators / VCpu ratio-proportionally if only this is set.

<a id="nestedatt--compute_quota_config--resource_sharing_config--absolute_borrow_limits--accelerator_partition"></a>
### Nested Schema for `compute_quota_config.resource_sharing_config.absolute_borrow_limits.accelerator_partition`

<a id="nestedatt--compute_quota_target"></a>
### Nested Schema for `compute_quota_target`

Read-Only:

- `fair_share_weight` (Number) Relative fair-share weight when fair-share scheduling is enabled on the parent ClusterSchedulerConfig. Defaults service-side to 0 when omitted.
- `team_name` (String) The name of the team. Materialized as Kubernetes namespace 'hyperpod-ns-<TeamName>' on the EKS cluster, so the value must satisfy RFC 1123 namespace constraints. Reassignment is not supported (createOnly).
